'''Diósgyőri Vasgyárak Testgyakorló Köre''', more commonly '''Diósgyőri VTK''' ({{IPA|hu|ˈdioːʒɟøːri ˈveːteːkaː|lang}}) is a professional [[Association football|football]] club from [[Hungary]]. Located in the [[Diósgyőr]] district of [[Miskolc]]. Founded in 1910 by the local working class youth, the club plays in the [[Nemzeti Bajnokság I]], the top flight of [[Hungarian football league system|Hungarian football]], and has spent most of its history in the top tier. Diósgyőr is best known for its passionate supporters – in the past years, Diósgyőr had one of the highest average attendances in the [[Hungarian League|Hungarian top division]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.rangado.hu/tartalom/cikk/266247_stagnal_a_nezoszam_az_nb_i_ben|title=Stagnál a nézőszám az NB I-ben|date=17 April 2014|publisher=rangado.hu|access-date=16 July 2014|archive-date=3 March 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160303212706/http://www.rangado.hu/tartalom/cikk/266247_stagnal_a_nezoszam_az_nb_i_ben|url-status=dead}}</ref> The [[football club]] enjoyed its first golden age in the late 1970s and early 1980s, including a third-place finish in the [[Nemzeti Bajnokság I 1978-79|1978–79 season]] of the [[Hungarian League]] and two [[Hungarian Cup]] triumphs in [[1976–77 Magyar Kupa|1977]] and [[1979–80 Magyar Kupa|1980]].
